narration.text: Một dashboard thể thao hư cấu gom dữ liệu trận đấu vào một màn hình rõ ràng.

beats.narrativeClaim: Dashboard thể thao hư cấu gom dữ liệu trận đấu vào một màn hình rõ ràng.
beats.visualIntent: Establish the fictional sports dashboard and show the data overview.
beats.setting: Stylized 3D studio with a floating sports dashboard, deep navy background.

visualEvidence.claim: The scene must visibly show one fictional sports dashboard containing organized match data.

prompt.positive: Fictional stylized 3D sports dashboard, one matte glass rectangular panel with electric blue frame and warm orange accent chip, organized sports match data overview with a clear readable layout, deep navy background, polished product animation, soft studio lighting, moderate perspective, mobile-safe composition, no real person likeness, no third-party logo.
prompt.negative: photorealistic person, real team logo, brand mark, watermark, unrelated landscape, unrelated vehicle, random collage, tiny unreadable UI text, extra dashboards

issues: Visual candidate has not been generated or semantically scored.

narration.text: Avatar hình khối chọn một trận đấu và xem trạng thái trực tiếp trong không gian sân vận động stylized.

beats.narrativeClaim: Avatar hình khối chọn một trận đấu và xem trạng thái trực tiếp trong không gian sân vận động stylized.
beats.visualIntent: Show the same dashboard and avatar moving into the stylized stadium context.
beats.setting: The same deep navy stylized stadium with a floating sports dashboard in the foreground.

visualEvidence.claim: The scene must visibly show the fictional avatar selecting one match while the same dashboard remains identifiable.

prompt.positive: Same fictional stylized 3D sports dashboard with matte glass rectangular panel, electric blue frame and warm orange accent chip, small geometric block avatar with soft gray body and electric blue shoulder accent selecting one match, selected match state, deep navy stylized stadium, same palette proportions and wardrobe, controlled orbit camera, soft studio lighting, mobile-safe composition.
prompt.negative: photorealistic athlete, new character design, different dashboard, real team logo, watermark, unrelated office, unrelated nature scene, random collage, unreadable text

issues: Repeated dashboard and avatar require continuity review before generation acceptance.

narration.text: Luồng kết thúc bằng một thẻ hành động màu cam, giúp người xem hiểu bước tiếp theo.

beats.narrativeClaim: Một thẻ hành động màu cam giải thích bước tiếp theo.
beats.visualIntent: Resolve the sequence with the same entities and one clear orange action card.
beats.setting: The same stylized stadium-dashboard scene, slightly wider camera framing for the closing card.

visualEvidence.claim: The scene must visibly show one warm orange action card as the next-step cue while the dashboard and avatar remain consistent.

prompt.positive: Same fictional stylized 3D sports dashboard, same small geometric block avatar with soft gray body and electric blue shoulder accent, one warm orange rounded action card with a clear next-step cue, matte glass and clean PBR plastic, deep navy stadium background, same palette proportions and wardrobe, soft readable shadows, controlled orbit camera, mobile-safe composition.
prompt.negative: multiple competing buttons, real brand call-to-action, photorealistic person, new character design, different dashboard, real logo, watermark, unrelated scene, random collage, tiny unreadable text

issues: Exact action-card text must be added deterministically after visual generation.
